campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for Pistachella Princess (KYP), expressing its creamy gourmand sweetness, refined nutty heart and warm rum finish.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images represent the same fragrance concept and olfactive identity, using a shared palette and core ingredients while giving each image its own composition.

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

fragrance_data.name: Pistachella Princess (KYP)
fragrance_data.description:
Pistachella Princess (KYP): un perfume gourmand femenino dulce, cremoso y adictivo

Pistachella Princess (KYP) es un perfume gourmand femenino que convierte la dulzura en una auténtica experiencia sensorial. Una fragancia atrevida y envolvente donde las notas más golosas se mezclan con frutos secos y un delicado toque licoroso para crear un aroma cálido, cremoso y difícil de olvidar.

Pensado para mujeres con personalidad, Pistachella Princess es el perfume perfecto para quienes disfrutan de fragancias intensas, originales y con una estela que deja huella.

 

 

¿A qué huele Pistachella Princess (KYP)?

Pistachella Princess (KYP) combina acordes gourmand, frutos secos y un fondo cálido para crear una fragancia dulce, sofisticada y tremendamente adictiva.

Una salida dulce e irresistible

La crema batida, el malvavisco y el algodón de azúcar protagonizan la apertura con una explosión cremosa y golosa que envuelve los sentidos desde el primer instante.

Un corazón cremoso y sofisticado

El pistacho y la avellana aportan una textura suave y elegante, creando un acorde gourmand refinado que añade personalidad y profundidad a la composición.

Un fondo cálido y envolvente

El ron aporta un matiz licoroso, cálido y seductor que completa la fragancia con una estela intensa, cremosa y muy duradera.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate the fragrance into a tactile visual story rather than literally representing every listed note.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every listed note by default.
Represent warmth and creaminess through color, texture, light and atmosphere without inventing additional ingredients.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by the fragrance data.
Use the same selected visual elements coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: The distinctive creamy, nutty heart and signature identity of the fragrance.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Natural pistachios in their pale shells and a restrained number of freshly opened kernels, with matte, finely textured surfaces and muted sage-green interiors.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Pistachio is the defining ingredient and gives the gourmand story its recognizable, elegant character.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Arrange several realistic pistachios and kernels in a compact, layered group near the bottle base, with a few naturally scattered pieces in the foreground.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Place a modest cluster of pistachios at varied depths around the bottle; a few individual kernels may be suspended nearby, never forming a geometric ring or covering the label.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: A warm, toasted nut nuance that adds depth and a refined roasted counterpoint.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Whole hazelnuts and a few naturally cracked shells revealing warm ivory kernels, with believable brown skins and delicate crumbs.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Hazelnut complements the pistachio and brings tactile contrast and toasted warmth without introducing a new olfactive note.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Build a smaller supporting cluster beside and slightly behind the pistachios, using whole and cracked nuts for natural variation.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Integrate a few whole and cracked hazelnuts into the midground at realistic scale, with slight depth separation and no artificial orbit around the bottle.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: The soft, airy and creamy sweetness of the opening.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: A small, physically plausible fold of whipped cream on a shallow warm-ivory ceramic surface, with delicate ridges and soft highlights rather than exaggerated sculptural peaks.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Cream communicates the fragrance's smooth gourmand texture and softens the nutty ingredients.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Use a restrained but clearly visible cream portion low in the still-life arrangement, separated from the bottle and balanced by open negative space for typography.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Show a few delicate cream droplets and a short suspended ribbon in the midground, with realistic viscosity and controlled motion; keep the bottle unobstructed.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: A pillowy confectionery sweetness supporting the creamy opening.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several small, softly powdered ivory marshmallows with lightly irregular edges and realistic matte surfaces.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Marshmallow adds a clear confectionery cue and tactile softness while remaining visually distinct from the cream.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Group a few marshmallows as a secondary element near the cream, with partial overlap and one or two pieces in the foreground.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Suspend a small number of marshmallows at staggered depths, with subtle rotation and natural spacing; avoid a halo or overly playful arrangement.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: A warm, mellow and gently boozy base that gives the sweetness depth.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: A thin, amber-gold liquid sheen in a small clear glass dish, with subtle reflections and a few believable suspended droplets.
selected_visual_notes.reason: The amber liquid suggests the warm licorice-like rum finish and anchors the cream-and-nut palette without adding unrelated props.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Place the shallow dish behind or beside the ingredient grouping, allowing a restrained amber reflection on the surface without competing with the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Use a narrow, controlled amber liquid stream and a few droplets flowing through the background plane, spatially behind the bottle and clearly separated from its silhouette.

shared_visual_identity.concept: A refined pistachio-and-cream confectionery world warmed by a subtle amber rum glow: indulgent, tactile and polished rather than sugary or whimsical.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Make the fragrance feel irresistibly smooth and comforting, with a confident, premium gourmand character.
key_materials: realistic perfume glass and reference-preserved cap
natural hazelnut skins and cracked shells
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: An intimate luxury patisserie-inspired studio world, expressed through restrained confectionery textures, warm stone, clear glass and soft amber light, without introducing ingredients beyond the listed notes.
visual_anchor_elements: a grounded cluster of pistachios and hazelnuts
soft ivory cream and marshmallow textures
a restrained amber rum-like liquid accent

editorial_still_life.concept: A richly layered yet refined gourmand still life: the bottle stands perfectly vertical on warm ivory stone, framed by realistic pistachio and hazelnut clusters, a modest fold of whipped cream, a few marshmallows and a subtle amber liquid accent.

environment.description: A tactile warm-ivory stone tabletop meets a softly graduated pistachio-sage and champagne-toned studio backdrop. The bottle is fully vertical and stable on the tabletop, with visible contact shadow. Ingredients gather around its base and in adjacent zones without touching or obscuring the bottle.
environment.background_rule: The environment may be a studio wall, architectural setting, elegant interior, natural landscape, stone setting or other appropriate environment depending on the fragrance.

visual_elements: One fully visible reference-accurate perfume bottle, upright and physically supported on the stone surface
Several pistachios, both whole and naturally opened, grouped in a compact cluster
A smaller supporting cluster of whole and cracked hazelnuts
A small, clearly visible fold of whipped cream on a shallow warm-ivory ceramic piece
A few softly powdered ivory marshmallows, grouped naturally near the cream
A small clear glass dish containing a restrained amber liquid sheen
Fine natural nut crumbs and subtle surface texture, kept within the still-life zone

composition.style: Rich layered premium still life with an original asymmetrical arrangement tailored to the nutty, creamy fragrance identity.
composition.element_density: Moderate variety of element types with generous quantities and natural groupings of the selected ingredients; materially abundant but not cluttered.
composition.negative_space: Generous, clean negative space in the upper-left portion for Spanish typography, with additional breathing room around the bottle silhouette.
composition.depth: Clear foreground nut details and a softly cropped marshmallow, a sharp midground bottle and ingredient groupings, and a softly graduated studio background.
composition.bottle_priority: Highest; the bottle is the sharpest, most legible and most visually prominent object, entirely unobstructed.

materials: warm ivory stone with fine natural grain
textured hazelnut skins and delicate cracked shells
clear glass dish with amber liquid
reference-accurate perfume glass, cap, label and materials

lighting.style: Premium commercial studio photography with soft, sculptural highlights on glass and food textures.
lighting.direction: Large diffused key light from upper left, with a restrained warm rim light from rear right to define the bottle and amber details.
lighting.contrast: Moderate, with legible label and natural shadow separation; avoid harsh glare and blown highlights.
lighting.quality: Naturalistic and controlled, with soft contact shadows and realistic reflections.

elements: Gourmand femenino de pistacho, avellana y ron
NOTAS DE SALIDA: crema batida, malvavisco y algodón de azúcar
NOTAS DE CORAZÓN: pistacho y avellana

style.hierarchy: Clear and sophisticated, with the perfume name prominent and supporting copy discreet.

rules: Typography must never cover the perfume bottle.
Keep all text legible against the background.
Integrate typography naturally into the reserved negative space.
Do not overload the image with text.

immersive_surreal.concept: The bottle is held in a suspended, gently swirling current of creamy light and amber warmth, within a spatially layered pistachio-and-hazelnut confectionery atmosphere. The surrealism comes from controlled suspension and depth, not oversized ingredients.

environment.description: A dimensional setting built from softly contoured warm-ivory stone planes, diffused pistachio-sage shadows and a restrained amber glow. The bottle floats near the visual centre and primary compositional axis, fully visible and isolated from overlapping ingredients. Its cap and top lean slightly left and its base slightly right, at a fixed, elegant 8-degree tilt. Foreground, midground and background remain physically coherent.

visual_elements: One fully visible, reference-accurate perfume bottle near the image centre, tilted 8 degrees with cap/top to the left and base to the right
A natural midground cluster of realistically scaled pistachios and hazelnuts positioned beside and behind the bottle
A few opened pistachios and cracked hazelnuts at varying depths, with some foreground pieces partially softened by depth of field
A controlled, narrow ribbon of whipped cream and a few small droplets moving behind the bottle
Several softly powdered marshmallows suspended at separate depths with subtle, physically plausible rotation
A slender amber liquid stream and a few droplets traveling through the background plane
Warm-ivory stone forms and soft atmospheric haze that extend naturally to the frame edges

composition.style: Dynamic asymmetrical composition built around a near-centred tilted bottle and a coherent flowing field of cream and amber light.
composition.element_density: Medium-rich, with the main ingredient group concentrated in the midground and selective foreground details creating immersion without clutter.
composition.depth: Strong foreground, midground and background separation: a few close, partly cropped nut details; bottle and grouped ingredients in the midground; dimensional stone planes and amber haze behind.
composition.bottle_priority: Highest; the bottle remains fully visible, sharply focused, clearly separated and dominant, with no ingredient crossing its cap, label or silhouette.
composition.negative_space: Controlled rather than empty; maintain a clear buffer around the bottle while allowing the atmospheric setting and ingredients to carry through the edges.

materials: realistic perfume glass and reference-preserved cap and label
matte pistachio shells and finely textured kernels
natural hazelnut skins and cracked shells
viscous whipped cream with believable folds and droplets
warm ivory stone and subtle volumetric haze

lighting.style: Cinematic commercial lighting grounded in photorealistic materials and spatial reflections.
lighting.direction: Soft directional key from upper left, with a warm rear-right rim and restrained amber illumination through the liquid.
lighting.contrast: Moderate-high atmospheric contrast while preserving clear bottle edges, readable label and natural ingredient color.
lighting.quality: Dramatic but photorealistic, with believable shadows, glass reflections and delicate haze.

negative_constraints: no added ingredients unsupported by fragrance notes
no text in the surreal image
no tilt in the editorial bottle
no ingredients obscuring the bottle cap or label
